thread:
Alex Gomez: Heads up — Q2 hosted API capacity planning thread. Need a buy vs lease recommendation for the May–June product push. Key constraints: eu-west H100 stock tight, lead time for purchases ~10–12 weeks, and we want to avoid p95 latency regressions.

Priya Shah: Quick forecast: baseline avg GPU-hours/week (Q1) = 120,000. Release traffic ramp expected +35% over 6 peak weeks => ~162,000 peak weekly GPU-hours. With current fleet and steady-state autoscaling, effective utilization sits ~65%. To keep p95 latency SLOs we need roughly +40 H100 equivalents (or mix of H100 + A100p at ~1.4x A100 capacity per H100) during the surge.

Priya Shah: Short summary (rough numbers):
```
baseline_weekly_gpu_hours: 120000
peak_weekly_gpu_hours: 162000
target_utilization: 75%
estimated_h100_needed: 40
lease_hourly_cost_h100: $3.40
buy_amortized_hourly_h100_36mo: $0.95
break_even_months: ~10
``` 

Mateo Alvarez: SRE notes: rack power/cooling checks for +40 H100s, driver/kernel validation, and NIC firmware. Leased nodes usually come with provider support but preemptible/spot options add churn — not acceptable for dedicated-tenant pools backing SLA customers. Also watch PCIe topology for large KV-cache models.

Jing Li: From finance: preference for blended capex/opex. If break-even is ~10 months, buying makes sense long-term but requires board capex sign-off. Suggest buy ~60% of needed capacity and lease 40% for the 6-week surge. Also include sensitivity scenarios for model-level efficiency (quantization could cut GPU-hours by ~10–15%).

Samir Patel: Product asks: can we reserve dedicated pools for enterprise customers and route noncritical traffic to leased or cloud spare capacity? Need a safe rollback plan if new hardware integration impacts serving. Also request latency/throughput target reminders: p50 < 50ms, p95 < 350ms for hosted gen endpoints.

capacity-bot: Procurement checklist added to thread: vendor RFQ deadline Mar 28, expected vendor lead time 10–14 weeks for H100 shipments, confirm rack space + PDUs, ask vendors for support SLAs and burn-in testing options.

Priya Shah: Proposed action items:
- RFQ 1: 40 H100s (60% buy, 40% lease mix) + optional 20 A100p as fallback
- RFQ 2: 6-month lease quotes for surge with price-lock and 24/7 vendor support
- Experiment: run quantization A/B on 20% traffic to measure real GPU-hour reduction (target 12%+ reclaim)
- Ops: update routing policy to prefer eu-west for EU traffic but allow fallback to us-west for capacity spikes

Jing Li: I'll model cashflow and present capex vs opex case with three scenarios (base/optimistic/quantized) by EOD Friday.

Mateo Alvarez: I'll run a preflight: power/network capacity and a driver compatibility matrix. ETA Tue.

Alex Gomez: Sounds good. Priya, open RFQs and drop vendor links in #vendors. Ping me on approvals if quotes cross $3.5M. :+1:

Samir Patel: I'll prepare an SLA-safe rollout plan and customer communication template if we need to throttle non-enterprise traffic.

Priya Shah: Taking lead on RFQs and quantization experiment. Will post numbers and a small table of vendor quotes once in.
